The '''Argazziis system''', also known as '''Argazda system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
